title: Guideline pathways
intro: Read only. This page shows the pathways the question engine uses, with the exact source sentence behind every step. To change a pathway, make a new version with the command line; nothing is edited here.

empty.title: No pathways are loaded
empty.body: Real pathways are added by the project owner and a clinician reviewer. Until then there is nothing to show.

testNote: This is a fake test pathway. It is not from any guideline and must never be used with a patient.
draftNote: This pathway is not active. It has not been signed off by a clinician.
unsignedNote: This pathway has no clinician sign-off recorded.
unsigned: Not signed off by a clinician
newVersionHint: An active version is never edited. A change is a new version made with the command line.
